summary: Completed testing of APScheduler cron job features for FeGrro construction hours app. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend verification confirmed the Cron card renders correctly in Tools tab with both 'Sprawdz status' and 'Uruchom recznie (test)' buttons working properly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/cron/status requires admin auth (returns 403 without token)
Backend: GET /api/cron/status with auth returns cron job status with active=true, job_id='monthly_excel_write', schedule, and next_run
Backend: POST /api/cron/trigger requires admin auth (returns 403 without token)
Backend: POST /api/cron/trigger with auth triggers cron job and returns message with status='triggered'
Backend: GET /api/sync/logs returns logs with 'trigger' field ('automatic' or 'manual')
Backend: POST /api/sync/write-hours?month=4&year=2026 starts write job successfully
Backend: POST /api/auth/admin/login works with admin@fegrro.pl / Admin123!
Backend: POST /api/auth/admin/login returns 401 for invalid credentials
Frontend: 'Automatyczny zapis (Cron)' card is visible in Tools tab
Frontend: 'Sprawdz status' button (cron-status-btn) is present and clickable
Frontend: 'Uruchom recznie (test)' button (cron-trigger-btn) is present and clickable
Frontend: Clicking 'Sprawdz status' shows toast with cron status and next run time
Frontend: Clicking 'Uruchom recznie (test)' shows toast confirming manual trigger
critical_code_review_comments: APScheduler integration is well implemented with AsyncIOScheduler and CronTrigger(day=2, hour=2, minute=0)
Scheduler is properly started in FastAPI startup event and shutdown in shutdown event
Cron endpoints correctly require admin authentication via get_current_admin dependency
The 'trigger' field is properly added to sync_logs for both automatic and manual triggers
Frontend Cron card UI matches the design with proper data-testid attributes for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: APScheduler cron job feature fully working. Scheduler runs on 2nd day of each month at 02:00 to write previous month's hours to Excel. GET /api/cron/status returns job status with next_run time. POST /api/cron/trigger manually triggers the cron job. Sync logs at GET /api/sync/logs include 'trigger' field ('automatic' or 'manual'). OneDrive operations return 'File not found' errors in preview environment - this is expected as the actual OneDrive file isn't accessible. Frontend Cron card in Tools tab has 'Sprawdz status' and 'Uruchom recznie (test)' buttons with proper data-testid attributes.

returns.message: Reczne uruchomienie crona: zapis godzin za {month}/{year}

write_hours_endpoint.note: OneDrive write fails with 'File not found' in preview env - expected

elements: Description text about 2nd day of month at 02:00

expected_onedrive_errors: OneDrive Graph API calls return 'File not found' errors in preview environment because the actual OneDrive file 'Wypłaty główny.xlsx' is not accessible. This is expected behavior as noted in the review request.
